original.statement: The `ruler.evaluation-delay-duration` CLI flag and corresponding YAML configuration setting are removed in Loki 3.0.0.

decision.reason: [ev-c0bb5c52ce78] says directly that the `ruler.evaluation-delay-duration` CLI flag is removed, in the upgrade guide section "Deprecated configuration options are removed". That supports the subject, the cli-flag named --ruler.evaluation-delay-duration (the flag's name with the leading dashes added). It also supports the change type "removed". The text names no specific component, so leaving the component out is right.
